requirement:
The FastAPI project below (entry point `app.main:app`) has a bug. Fix it so the behaviour described in SPEC holds, keep every existing endpoint/function and its signature, and return the COMPLETE corrected project including its unit tests (add a test that would have caught the bug).

SYMPTOM: `GET /items?page=1&size=10` returns items 11-20 instead of the first ten, and page 3 of 23 items is empty.

SPEC: Pages are 1-based: page=1 returns items 1..size, page=2 the next `size` items, and so on. A page past the end returns an empty list. `total` is always the full item count.

Existing project files:

File `app/main.py`:
```python
from fastapi import FastAPI, Query

app = FastAPI()
ITEMS = [f"item-{i}" for i in range(1, 24)]


def paginate(items, page, size):
    start = page * size
    return items[start : start + size]


@app.get("/items")
def list_items(page: int = Query(1, ge=1), size: int = Query(10, ge=1, le=50)):
    data = paginate(ITEMS, page, size)
    return {"page": page, "size": size, "total": len(ITEMS), "items": data}
```
acceptance_criteria: Out-of-range pages return an empty list
